full_judgment: 3. It was the case of the plaintiffs that the land measuring 2.46 acres of C.S. Khatian No.528, land measuring 3.62 acres of C.S. Khatian No.529 and half of 2.30 acres of land of C.S. Khatian No.856 belonged to Chanderaddi Khandoker and he died leaving a widow Shahejan and son Akkel Ali and two daughters Habetonnessa and Shahera through first wife and three sons namely, Sadar Ali, Shahar Ali and Aiub Ali through the second wife. The plaintiff claimed title in the suit alnd on the basis of inheritance but it was disclosed for the first time in Falgun, 1386 B.S. by son of Sadar Ali Khandoker that the plaintiff has transferred her share in respect of land by Heba to Sadar Ali Khandoker. Thereupon the plaintiff obtained the certified copy of the said Heba deeds. It is the contention of the plaintiff that the said Heba deeds are forged, fraudulent and fabricated.
